title: NVIDIA to Acquire Hugging Face
summary: I’m excited to announce that NVIDIA has agreed to acquire Hugging Face for $12,930,300,000. Together, we will scale Hugging Face’s platform, strengthen its infrastructure and expand access to AI for developers and institutions worldwide. Over the past decade, Clem, Julien, Thomas and the team at Hugging Face have built something remarkable: a vibrant home for […]
title_es: NVIDIA adquiere Hugging Face por $12.9 mil millones
bajada: NVIDIA ha acordado comprar Hugging Face, la plataforma que aloja más de 3 millones de modelos de IA y es utilizada por 18 millones de desarrolladores. La adquisición refuerza la posición de NVIDIA en el ecosistema de IA open-source y consolida su control sobre la infraestructura de desarrollo.
bajada_en: NVIDIA has agreed to acquire Hugging Face, the platform hosting over 3 million AI models used by 18 million developers. The acquisition strengthens NVIDIA's position in the open-source AI ecosystem and consolidates its control over development infrastructure.

title: Nvidia RTX Spark ‘Superchip’: The First AI PCs Are Here
summary: At IFA 2026, Nvidia and its partners showed off the first RTX Spark-powered laptops and mini PCs, designed to run AI models right on your computer.
title_es: NVIDIA RTX Spark: los primeros AI PCs llegan al mercado
bajada: NVIDIA mostró en IFA 2026 los primeros laptops y mini PCs con RTX Spark, permitiendo ejecutar modelos de IA directamente en dispositivos personales. Esta generación de computadoras marca el inicio de una nueva era donde la IA local es práctica y accesible.
bajada_en: NVIDIA showcased at IFA 2026 the first laptops and mini PCs with RTX Spark, enabling AI models to run directly on personal devices. This generation of computers marks the beginning of a new era where local AI is practical and accessible.

title: Give Your Coding Agents a Memory You Own
title_es: Agentes de código con memoria propia y controlable
bajada: Hugging Face lanza Funes, una herramienta que permite a agentes de IA mantener memoria persistente sobre su trabajo sin depender de terceros. La solución es relevante para desarrolladores que construyen sistemas autónomos con mayor control y privacidad.
bajada_en: Hugging Face launches Funes, a tool allowing AI agents to maintain persistent memory about their work without relying on third parties. The solution is relevant for developers building autonomous systems with greater control and privacy.

title: Google’s latest AI weather model gives you no excuse to forget your umbrella
summary: WeatherNext 3 is the latest wave of a sea change in meteorology brought out by deep learning techniques. Google says it will start feeding into weather information users see in search, Google Maps, and Gemini.
title_es: Google lanza WeatherNext 3: predicción meteorológica con IA
bajada: Google presenta su nuevo modelo de IA para predicciones meteorológicas con resolución sin precedentes, especialmente mejorado en predicción de lluvia y nieve. El modelo estará disponible en Search, Maps y Gemini, democratizando acceso a mejores pronósticos.
bajada_en: Google introduces its new AI weather model with unprecedented resolution, especially improved at predicting rain and snowfall. The model will be available in Search, Maps, and Gemini, democratizing access to better forecasts.

summary: Google is rolling out an updated AI weather model that's supposed to be more accurate, especially when it comes to predicting rain and snowfall. In the announcement today, the company says it's now able to make forecasts with "unprecedented resolution" using its new WeatherNext 3 AI model. It can produce a global picture that's five […]

title: Google says its new Gemini 3.8 Flash model ‘works harder’ but might cost more
summary: Google launched Gemini 3.8 Flash, arriving just a few weeks after its predecessor. The company claims the new model "works harder" than Gemini 3.7 Flash by performing more reasoning steps on complex tasks and "calling tools iteratively." It has the same introductory pricing as 3.7 Flash, $0.75 per million input tokens and $3.75 per million […]
title_es: Google lanza Gemini 3.8 Flash con más razonamiento
bajada: Google lanzó Gemini 3.8 Flash con mejoras en razonamiento y uso iterativo de herramientas, manteniendo los mismos precios introductorios que su predecesor. El modelo llega solo semanas después de Gemini 3.7 Flash, reflejando el ritmo acelerado de iteración de Google.
bajada_en: Google launched Gemini 3.8 Flash with improvements in reasoning and iterative tool use, maintaining the same introductory pricing as its predecessor. The model arrives just weeks after Gemini 3.7 Flash, reflecting Google's accelerated iteration pace.

title: Scaling agentic AI pilots across the enterprise
summary: As agentic AI moves from experimentation toward enterprise deployment, the challenge is figuring out how agents can work together, connect to the systems and data they need, and operate safely across the workflows that run a business. Although agentic AI has been adopted by some 80% of Fortune 500 companies, progress toward meaningful scale remains…
title_es: Escalando pilotos de IA agentic en empresas
bajada: El 80% de empresas Fortune 500 ha adoptado IA agentic, pero el desafío ahora es escalar desde pilotos a producción real integrando múltiples agentes con sistemas empresariales. Los desarrolladores deben resolver problemas de coordinación, seguridad y conectividad de datos.
bajada_en: 80% of Fortune 500 companies have adopted agentic AI, but the challenge now is scaling from pilots to real production integrating multiple agents with enterprise systems. Developers must solve coordination, security, and data connectivity problems.

title: NeoMME: an efficient Multimodal-native and Multilingual Encoder
title_es: NeoMME: un encoder multimodal y multilingüe eficiente
bajada: Hugging Face presenta NeoMME, un nuevo modelo que combina capacidades multimodales y multilingües con eficiencia computacional mejorada. El modelo amplía las opciones disponibles para desarrolladores que trabajan con contenido multimedia en múltiples idiomas.
bajada_en: Hugging Face introduces NeoMME, a new model combining multimodal and multilingual capabilities with improved computational efficiency. The model expands options for developers working with multimedia content across multiple languages.

title: Fine-tuning a 350M Model for Better Structured Outputs in 100 GRPO Steps
title_es: Fine-tuning eficiente de modelos con GRPO en 100 pasos
bajada: Hugging Face demuestra cómo ajustar un modelo de 350M parámetros para generar outputs estructurados de manera eficiente utilizando GRPO. Esta técnica reduce significativamente los recursos necesarios para especializar modelos en tareas específicas.
bajada_en: Hugging Face demonstrates how to fine-tune a 350M parameter model for structured outputs efficiently using GRPO. This technique significantly reduces resources needed to specialize models for specific tasks.

title: ChatGPT, Grok, and Claude all went down at the same time
summary: OpenAI's ChatGPT, xAI's Grok, and Anthropic's Claude are all experiencing issues. At around 11AM ET, ChatGPT started returning error messages for users trying to use the chatbot, with its status page saying there are currently "elevated errors across ChatGPT and Codex." In addition to preventing users from having conversations with ChatGPT, the outage is also […]
title_es: ChatGPT, Grok y Claude sufren caída simultánea
bajada: ChatGPT, Grok y Claude experimentaron problemas de servicio al mismo tiempo, con ChatGPT retornando errores y su status page reportando problemas elevados. El incidente subraya la importancia de la redundancia y resiliencia en servicios críticos de IA.
bajada_en: ChatGPT, Grok, and Claude experienced service issues simultaneously, with ChatGPT returning errors and its status page reporting elevated problems. The incident underscores the importance of redundancy and resilience in critical AI services.

title: Proactive cyber defense for governments and enterprises
title_es: Google presenta Fairwind: defensa cibernética proactiva con IA
bajada: Google lanzó el programa Fairwind para ofrecer defensa cibernética proactiva a gobiernos y empresas usando capacidades de IA. La iniciativa posiciona a Google como proveedor de soluciones de seguridad crítica para instituciones públicas.
bajada_en: Google launched the Fairwind program to provide proactive cyber defense to governments and enterprises using AI capabilities. The initiative positions Google as a provider of critical security solutions for public institutions.

title: This Is Flock’s AI Search Tool for Cops
summary: WIRED rebuilt Flock’s latest search tool from code the company sends to a police officer’s browser. Its AI can keep watch across multiple cameras for anyone fitting a written description.
title_es: Flock: herramienta de búsqueda por IA para cuerpos policiales
bajada: Flock desarrolló una herramienta de búsqueda con IA que permite a la policía monitorear múltiples cámaras buscando personas por descripción escrita. La tecnología plantea importantes preguntas sobre privacidad y vigilancia en contextos de aplicación de la ley.
bajada_en: Flock developed an AI-powered search tool allowing police to monitor multiple cameras searching for people by written description. The technology raises important questions about privacy and surveillance in law enforcement contexts.
